stage0084_03:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Was it you who summoned me,
　Olympus's King of the Underworld?」

stage0084_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Embodiment of darkness.
　Was it not you who summoned me?」

stage0084_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Seems you too received a summons.」

stage0084_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh... I have a rough idea
　who's behind this.」

stage0084_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Very well.
　This gathering, too, must be some kind of fate...
　Let us talk a while.」

stage0084_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Claim over that blue star
　belongs to the gods of Olympus.
　I have nothing more to say.」

stage0084_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Rather admirable, for one
　who bears the name Demon King.」

stage0084_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Or do you mean, shamelessly,
　to profit off a fight between
　the gods of Olympus and mankind?」

stage0084_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Watch your mouth.
　Do you want to start
　the real war here?」

stage0084_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「My apologies...
　But the one I must defeat
　lies elsewhere.」

stage0084_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Them, hm...
　That wish is ours as well.」

stage0084_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Then what of the dimensional cage?」

stage0084_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「I know not what purpose lay
　behind hiding that star, but to us,
　such a thing means nothing.」

stage0084_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh... though the humans
　are running around in circles.」

stage0084_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「But do not underestimate them.
　They've already entered the Age of the Sun.」

stage0084_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「The one who holds that key is him...」

stage0084_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The man known as the Red Comet...」

stage0084_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Fufufu... it should be a sight,
　seeing how far humans can go.」

stage0084_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「By the time we next meet,
　things will likely have moved.」

stage0084_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Until then, let us part for a while...」

stage0084_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「For us who live forever,
　that is but a moment's time, though...」

stage0084_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$カヲル$$
「...Did you want to show me them?」

stage0084_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$カヲル$$
「Those who forgot their duty as higher beings...
　But I can't bring myself to hate them
　for living by their desires.」

stage0084_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$カヲル$$
「We do not needlessly interfere
　with our immature brothers...
　Such a rule is merely presumptuous.」

stage0084_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$カヲル$$
「In truth, you committed a grave sin
　24,000 years ago.」

stage0084_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$カヲル$$
「And further, 12,000 years ago,
　I acknowledge one who overturned
　the cycle of rebirth... of fate.」

stage0084_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$カヲル$$
「And you told a painful lie
　to divert their eyes and protect
　your former lover.」

stage0084_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$カヲル$$
「That's right...
　That's why we need a future.」

stage0084_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$カヲル$$
「No gods, no humans...
　A future where everyone lives freely
　and earnestly for the world they want...」

stage0084_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Any word on Supreme Commander $$不動$$ since then?」

stage0084_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Chairwoman $$クレア$$ says
　there's been no word at all.」

stage0084_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Now that Altair's taken
　the Mythical Aquarion,
　just where could he be...」

stage0084_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$ミコノ$$
（Nothing makes sense anymore...
　Not about me... not about $$アマタ$$ and that person...
　Not about Supreme Commander $$不動$$ either...）

stage0084_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Sorry, $$アマタ$$.
　I'm... a little tired, so I'll go rest, okay...」

stage0084_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$葵$$
「Leave her be for a bit, $$アマタ$$.
　$$ミコノ$$'s confused too, being told
　about a past life out of nowhere.」

stage0084_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$朔哉$$
「You ever feel like lifting
　a leg in the bathroom?」

stage0084_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$朔哉$$
「That... I got curious how much
　dog memory's still in you...」

stage0084_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$朔哉$$
「My bad, my bad.
　Sorry if that upset you.」

stage0084_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$葵$$
「Well... I bet our past lives
　were animals too, though.」

stage0084_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$くらら$$
「So really, how is it?
　Did anything change, learning you're
　the wing dog and Apollo reincarnated?」

stage0084_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Honestly, I'm not sure...
　It doesn't feel real either.」

stage0084_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$アマタ$$
「So I've decided not to think
　about it, and just live as myself.」

stage0084_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$朔哉$$
「That's the way.
　Even we who knew Apollo don't really
　get it, being told it's reincarnation.」

stage0084_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「I think so too.
　Being bound by a past life only
　narrows your own possibilities.」

stage0084_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$朔哉$$
「So that means I've got the right
　to go after $$ミコノ$$ too.」

stage0084_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$カイエン$$
「If you want to exercise it,
　beat me first.」

stage0084_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Next to a tough spot like this,
　beating that $$カグラ$$ guy should
　be a breeze, right, $$アマタ$$?」

stage0084_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Yeah.
　...Thanks, $$朔哉$$.
　As always, putting your body on the line for a laugh.」

stage0084_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Being seen as that kind of guy
　is a problem too, though...」

stage0084_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「What bothers me is that number,
　12,000.」

stage0084_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$くらら$$
「I don't think so.
　By the 'Book of Twin Stars', reincarnation
　in the world of Aquaria runs on a 12,000-year cycle.」

stage0084_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「Reincarnation... the cycle of rebirth...
　in other words, 'the Cycle,' is it...」

stage0084_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Then does that word mean reincarnation?」

stage0084_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$朔哉$$
「What's it mean for that to close?」

stage0084_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「It's all a mystery.
　We'll just have to ask someone who knows.」

stage0084_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Someone who knows...
　Supreme Commander $$不動$$, maybe...」

stage0084_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$甲児$$
「Still, that guy... seems like
　he's hiding something still.」

stage0084_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$渓$$
「Yeah. Like knowing about
　the Mythical Aquarion, or bringing
　$$ランカ$$ and $$シェリル$$ out of nowhere...」

stage0084_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$凱$$
「Maybe he even knows the way
　to the Altair realm, how to break
　the Prison of Time, and where the singularity is.」

stage0084_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$甲児$$
「Even so, that's a bit much, isn't it.」

stage0084_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「That's right.
　It's not like he's a god.」

stage0084_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$くらら$$
「But I do wish he'd tell us
　what he knows. Both we and the world
　are on the edge.」

stage0084_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$カイエン$$
「It's pointless looking for logic
　in Supreme Commander $$不動$$'s actions.」

stage0084_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「But people like that always turn out
　to be the hottest and kindest
　on the inside, right?」

stage0084_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Coach, for me and Big Sis,
　was like that too.」

stage0084_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$甲児$$
「The one who left that famous line,
　'combine fire with fire
　and become a flame'?」

stage0084_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「That's right.
　$$ガンバスター$$ and I are here today
　all thanks to Coach.」

stage0084_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Not at aaall!
　Because Coach is someone precious to Big Sis.」

stage0084_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「What's wrong, $$甲児$$?
　If you stare at me that much,
　$$さやか$$'s gonna get mad.」

stage0084_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$甲児$$
「N-no, that's not it...!
　I just thought $$ノリコ$$'s
　really amazing...」

stage0084_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$渓$$
「Yeah. A battle-hardened warrior,
　thrown alone into this world, the hero
　who saved humanity with $$ガンバスター$$.」

stage0084_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Ahaha, that's the kind of compliment
　that'd shock my old friends,
　if they heard it.」

stage0084_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$朔哉$$
「By the way, has Mycenae
　made any moves since then?」

stage0084_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「Doesn't seem like it.
　They did say they'd crush $$エタニティ・フラット$$,
　but to them, that's likely trivial.」

stage0084_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$號$$
「Naturally.
　They're already beings you could call eternal.」

stage0084_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$號$$
「One who has grasped eternity...
　That is a god.」

stage0084_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Even if you suddenly say something like that...」

stage0084_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$凱$$
「Don't worry about it, $$ノリコ$$.
　$$號$$'s just abrupt like that.」

stage0084_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Still, leaving Mycenae alone
　is dangerous.」

stage0084_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Yeah...
　If we could, I'd want to use their power
　to break through the Prison of Time, but...」

stage0084_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$アドヴェント$$ says they'll apparently
　start moving too, once
　$$エタニティ・フラット$$'s at hand.」

stage0084_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$甲児$$
「Mycenae thinks humanity's existence
　is like garbage.
　We can't let them do as they please.」

stage0084_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$甲児$$
「The singularity search matters too,
　but let's fight the enemy
　in front of us first.」

stage0084_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$渓$$
「But if we don't know where they are,
　there's nothing we can do」

stage0084_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$甲児$$, you're friends with that golden
　god $$ゼウス$$, aren't you?
　Isn't there any way to reach him?」

stage0084_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「If we did, I feel like we could work out
　where Mycenae is and how to break
　the Prison of Time」

stage0084_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$甲児$$
「Don't say it so easily...!
　I met $$ゼウス$$ while I was wandering
　the line between life and death」

stage0084_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Then shall we try recreating
　that situation?」

stage0084_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「When you say it, it doesn't
　sound like a joke」

stage0084_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「Though it's a problem too when
　everything you say gets taken as
　a joke, like with $$朔哉$$」

stage0084_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$朔哉$$
「I knew it, I ended up in
　that position, huh...」

stage0084_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$甲児$$
「But if there's a way to contact
　$$ゼウス$$, we might be able to
　turn this situation around...」

stage0084_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$號$$
「That's right.
　That's what connects
　you and $$ゼウス$$」

stage0084_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$スズネ$$
「...So, $$甲児$$... you've been shut in
　the Pilder this whole time」

stage0084_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$n
「Just how long has he been
　like that?」

stage0084_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$セイミー$$
「About two hours now,
　I'd guess」

stage0084_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$渓$$
「$$號$$... will a method like
　this really work?」

stage0084_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$カレン$$
「He's not just asleep,
　is he?」

stage0084_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$宗介$$
「This one's knack for tuning
　things out... on par with
　$$キリコ$$?」

stage0084_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$凱$$
「$$タケル$$...
　Can't you do something
　with your telepathy?」

stage0084_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$タケル$$
「I'm trying, but it's probably
　impossible unless it's $$甲児$$,
　whose bond with $$ゼウス$$ is strong」

stage0084_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$アルト$$
「What do we do? Have $$刹那$$'s
　Quanta scatter GN particles
　to expand $$甲児$$'s mind?」

stage0084_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$タケル$$
「Doing it aimlessly has its
　limits, even for $$刹那$$ and
　the Quanta」

stage0084_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$n
「Guess all we can do now is
　keep at it patiently...」

stage0084_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$セイミー$$
「That's rare.
　You, showing up
　in a place like this」

stage0084_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「My heart belongs to $c too,
　you know. I can't stay quiet
　when everyone's in a bind」

stage0084_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I recommend equipping this
　around $$マジンガーＺ$$'s cockpit」

stage0084_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Something more precious to me
　than my own life...
　A Z-Chip」

stage0084_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$甲児$$
（The Z-Chip...
　This is what amplifies
　my mental wavelength...）

stage0084_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$甲児$$
（But that $$ＡＧ$$...
　What's he planning, hoarding
　up Z-Chips...?）

stage0084_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$セイミー$$
「Can you hear me, $$甲児$$?
　I dimmed the lights to help
　you concentrate, so do your best」

stage0084_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$甲児$$
「Thanks, $$セイミー$$.
　Please tell $$ＡＧ$$ I'm
　grateful too」

stage0084_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$セイミー$$
「Roger.
　I'm counting on you, then」

stage0084_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$甲児$$
「This place... it's
　from that time...!」

stage0084_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「So, humanity has finally
　managed to come here
　under its own power」

stage0084_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「I have been waiting.
　For you all... for humanity
　to come here by your own strength」

stage0084_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「As I thought, you are trying
　to live in the Age of the Sun」

stage0084_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$甲児$$
「Those words... I've heard
　them a few times before」

stage0084_03:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「The universe repeats death
　and rebirth, and within it,
　people evolve, little by little」

stage0084_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Beast's blood, water's joining,
　wind's path, fire's civilization...
　Through these, people reach the sun's light」

stage0084_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「And what awaits beyond that
　is the path to godhood」

stage0084_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$甲児$$
「The path to godhood...
　What exactly is that?」

stage0084_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「That's an answer you must
　seize with your own hands.
　Not something taught by another」

stage0084_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$甲児$$
「What is it!?
　Why do $$アドヴェント$$ and Supreme
　Commander $$不動$$ both drag this out!?」

stage0084_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「It's because the time has come
　for you, as living beings, to enter
　a new stage and touch the universe's truth」

stage0084_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「By rights, we, as forerunners,
　are meant to watch over those
　who walk the path to higher life」

stage0084_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「But the gods of Olympus forgot
　their duty, destroying others to
　become overlord of the universe itself」

stage0084_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$甲児$$
「Where are they? If Mycenae means
　to turn Earth into a base for their
　war against $$バアル$$, we have to stop it」

stage0084_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Fighting $$ハーデス$$ with your own
　strength will be extremely difficult」

stage0084_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$甲児$$
「If we don't fight, who'll
　protect people's peace
　and freedom...!」

stage0084_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Those eyes... they hold what
　the gods of Olympus forgot」

stage0084_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Love, courage, and justice...
　As I thought, you are the ones
　fit to inherit the power of light」

stage0084_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「The task of stopping the
　gods' cruelty... I entrust it
　to you, along with my power」

stage0084_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「I will tell you the site of the
　decisive battle, $$兜甲児$$...
　trusting that light will fill it again」

stage0084_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$甲児$$
「The Peloponnese Peninsula
　in Greece... They're waiting
　for us there」

stage0084_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$アンディ$$
「So beyond that light lies
　the Altair realm, and
　$$ＭＩＸ$$ is there」

stage0084_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$, too」

stage0084_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$アマタ$$
「This is the hope $$ゼウス$$ gave us,
　trusting us. We'll get $$ＭＩＸ$$ and
　the others back, no matter what」

stage0084_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「To think the space beast outbreaks
　were caused by the universe's rebirth,
　happening on a 12,000-year cycle...」

stage0084_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$カレン$$
「Then the universe
　$$ノリコ$$ was in...」

stage0084_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「It's okay, $$カレン$$.
　I don't believe the
　universe is going to end」

stage0084_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Right. No such phenomenon
　has ever turned up in
　archaeology, either」

stage0084_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$シン$$
「So it was just
　Mycenae's bluff, huh」

stage0084_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I'd like to
　think so」

stage0084_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（But with the number 12,000 years
　coming up this often, there must
　be some meaning behind it...）

stage0084_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$甲児$$
「Even if that's the truth,
　we have no choice but
　to move forward」

stage0084_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$甲児$$
「Carving out the future
　through willpower alone...
　That's the duty $$ゼウス$$ gave us」

stage0084_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$甲児$$
（$$ゼウス$$...
　I'll live up to that
　expectation, no matter what）

stage0084_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$甲児$$
（With $$マジンガーＺ$$,
　which inherited your soul）

stage0084_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$竜馬$$
「I get what you're trying
　to say, $$號$$.
　...Getter rays, right?」

stage0084_03:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$竜馬$$
「That $$ハーデス$$ bastard seemed
　to know something about
　Getter rays, too」

stage0084_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$竜馬$$
「And on top of that, he was
　trying to say something about
　a me that I don't even know」

stage0084_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$竜馬$$
「How I live is mine to decide.
　It's not something anyone
　else gets to weigh in on」

stage0084_03:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Whatever happens to me
　from here, I'll see it
　with my own eyes」

stage0084_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$號$$
「And that goes for all of
　humanity too. We must face
　the future with our own eyes」

stage0084_03:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Heh... gets me excited,
　thinking there's an unknown
　world waiting up ahead」

stage0084_03:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That anticipation from Master
　$$竜馬$$ and duty from Master $$號$$
　made 100Z of Z-Chips, now in the squad stock」

stage0084_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$竜馬$$
「But this time, I gotta hand
　it to you, $$ＡＧ$$. Spending your
　own money to help $$甲児$$ out」

stage0084_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Naturally. If I lost you all,
　I would also lose my own means
　of obtaining Z-Chips, you know」

stage0084_03:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$竜馬$$
「That miserly streak of
　yours reminds me
　of someone」

stage0084_03:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$號$$
「No, never mind...
　I'm sure you carry
　the same duty I do」

stage0084_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm not quite sure, but I
　think that's... giving me
　too much credit...」

stage0084_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$甲児$$
「Thanks, $$ＡＧ$$. Thanks to
　the Z-Chips you gave me,
　I got to meet $$ゼウス$$」

stage0084_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm glad I could
　be of help」

stage0084_03:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$ゼウス$$ was glad humans came to
　meet him under our own power, but
　does that connect to using the Z-Chip?」

stage0084_03:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... I couldn't possibly
　know what a god is
　thinking...」

stage0084_03:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$甲児$$
「Just what is a Z-Chip, anyway?
　You say it's emotion given form,
　but isn't there a greater power behind it?」

stage0084_03:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What I know is that the Z-Chip
　can be used as a catalyst
　to activate $$オリジン・ロー$$」

stage0084_03:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$オリジン・ロー$$... you mean
　$$次元力$$...」

stage0084_03:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's right. So I thought it
　could carry Master $$甲児$$'s voice
　across dimensions, to Master $$ゼウス$$」

stage0084_03:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$甲児$$
「Then if we use Z-Chips, maybe
　we could bring out enough power
　to break the Prison of Time?」

stage0084_03:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Unfortunately, not quite
　that far. Our current stock
　falls far short of that much $$次元力|lc$$」

stage0084_03:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「By my calculations, we'd need
　enough Z-Chips to build a cube
　over 50 meters on each side」

stage0084_03:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now, don't be so discouraged.
　Didn't you just swear to carve
　out the future through willpower?」

stage0084_03:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, now that your
　spirits are back, shall
　we get to it!」

stage0084_03:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$甲児$$
「Guess I can't turn you
　down today, of all days」

stage0084_03:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Here we go, then!
　Let's get fired up today too!」
